jobDescription: A manufacturer of commercial fryers, combination ovens and griddles sells to restaurant chains and contract caterers. The product manager for the fryer range is responsible for its roadmap, writes specifications with engineering, works with the quality team on field reliability and supports sales on large tenders. Reliability improvements are reported from warranty claims data per thousand installed units, compared year on year with the same claim definition. The role sits in the commercial team and spends regular time in customer kitchens and at distributor training days.
requirements: Maintains a product roadmap and writes product specifications with engineering.
Works with quality engineering on field failures and corrective actions.
Shows a measured reduction in warranty claims or field failures against a defined baseline year.
Supports sales on tenders for national restaurant or catering accounts, including pricing and service-level terms.
Gathers customer requirements through site visits or structured interviews with kitchen operators.

evidence.text: Maintained the three-year roadmap for the fryer range at Castell Foodservice Equipment and wrote the specification for the 2023 high-efficiency fryer with the engineering team.
Joined the quality engineers' corrective-action reviews on heating-element failures reported from the field in 2022; the reviews decided on a new element supplier and an added burn-in test.
Visited 14 restaurant and catering kitchens to watch fryers in use during service, and wrote up each visit for the specification team.
Prepared the technical response sections for two national restaurant-chain tenders and attended the product demonstrations with the sales team.
Ran launch training for distributors on the high-efficiency fryer, covering cleaning and oil-management routines.

Work sample: an excerpt of the high-efficiency fryer specification, with the oil-capacity and recovery-time requirements, the heating-element specification after the supplier change and the engineering sign-off page.
Reference check summary: Castell's former head of quality confirmed by email that the candidate attended the 2022 heating-element corrective-action reviews as the product representative.

HR verification note: the warranty report the candidate referred to was supplied directly by Castell's quality department. It shows heating-element warranty claims on the fryer range falling from 38 per 1,000 installed units in 2021 to 17 per 1,000 in 2023, using the same claim definition in both years.

propositions.text: Heating-element warranty claims on the fryer range fell from 38 per 1,000 installed units in 2021 to 17 per 1,000 in 2023, using the same claim definition, according to the warranty report supplied by the former employer's quality department.
propositions.rationale: The verification note records an employer-supplied report with a baseline year, comparison year and constant claim definition; the resume and reference check document the candidate's part in the corrective-action reviews.
